MARTA KOWAL-BRANDT
QA Automation Engineer transitioning to DevOps / Platform Engineering
Wroclaw, Poland | marta.kowalbrandt@example.com | +48 555 303 303 | gitlab.com/mkb-example

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
QA automation engineer with 7 years of experience, including two years focused primarily on CI/CD pipelines, test environments and build tooling. Hands-on experience owning GitLab CI pipelines for three product teams and building Helm-based ephemeral environments on a shared Kubernetes cluster. Personal infrastructure work includes a k3s homelab, Terraform-provisioned Hetzner VPS infrastructure and introductory AWS learning. Seeking to move into a DevOps or platform engineering role.

TECHNICAL SKILLS
CI/CD and containers: GitLab CI, Jenkins, Docker, Docker Compose
Infrastructure and platforms: Kubernetes (namespace-level access; k3s homelab), Helm, Terraform (personal projects), Ansible (basic), Linux
Monitoring and data: Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, PostgreSQL, SQL
Programming and testing: Python, Bash, Java (test code), pytest, Playwright, Selenium, Postman
Cloud learning: AWS (EC2 and S3 basics)
Other: Git, Argo CD

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
QA Automation Engineer (Test Infrastructure) | Odrava Health Software, Wroclaw | 2021-present
- Own GitLab CI pipelines for three product teams (~25 developers), covering builds, unit, integration and end-to-end test stages, and artifact publishing.
- Reduced average pipeline time from 38 to 14 minutes by parallelising test jobs, caching dependencies and separating end-to-end tests into their own stage; monthly CI runner costs fell by about 30%.
- Built merge-request ephemeral environments with Docker Compose and later Helm on the company's shared Kubernetes cluster, including application services, PostgreSQL and seeded data; environments are removed after merge or 48 hours of inactivity.
- Maintain a pytest and Playwright end-to-end suite of about 900 tests.
- Built a flaky-test dashboard using Python, PostgreSQL, Grafana and the GitLab API; the flaky rate fell from 7% to below 1% after teams addressed the top offenders.
- Wrote Bash and Python tooling to seed PostgreSQL test data and documented how the CI system works for team onboarding.
- Mentored two QA interns in 2023.

QA Engineer | Brightmill Software House, Wroclaw | 2019-2021
- Tested web and mobile applications through manual and automated testing for client projects.
- Introduced a Java and Selenium automated regression suite for the largest client project.
- Configured Jenkins jobs to run nightly regression tests.

Customer Support Specialist (2nd line) | Brightmill Software House | 2018-2019
- Investigated customer issues using logs and databases and reproduced bugs for developers.

SELECTED INFRASTRUCTURE PROJECT
Homelab k3s Cluster with GitOps | Personal | 2024-2025
- Built a three-node k3s cluster on Raspberry Pi 5 devices, with applications deployed from a Git repository using Argo CD.
- Set up Prometheus, Grafana and Loki for monitoring, plus Traefik ingress and cert-manager for TLS.
- Provisioned infrastructure for a small Hetzner VPS with Terraform; used Ansible at a basic level.

EDUCATION
BEng Computer Engineering | Silesian Lowlands University of Technology | 2018

CERTIFICATIONS AND PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT
ISTQB Foundation Level | 2019
Preparing for the Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) exam, scheduled for January 2027

LANGUAGES
Polish (native), English (C1), German (A2)
docs.cover_letter:
Dear Corvale Mobility hiring team,

I am applying for the Cloud Infrastructure / DevOps Contractor role. My experience combines CI/CD ownership for three product teams with hands-on Kubernetes-based test environments, and I am now looking to move into DevOps and platform engineering. The chance to contribute to infrastructure for Corvale's new train fleet particularly interests me because it brings software delivery and real-world connectivity together.

At Odrava Health Software, I own GitLab CI pipelines used by around 25 developers. By parallelising jobs, caching dependencies and restructuring end-to-end testing, I reduced average pipeline time from 38 to 14 minutes and monthly runner costs by about 30%. I also built short-lived merge-request environments using Helm on a shared Kubernetes cluster, with PostgreSQL and seeded data, so QA and product teams can review changes and run end-to-end tests before merge. I document the CI system for onboarding and have mentored two QA interns.

I have also built a personal three-node k3s homelab with GitOps deployments, Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, ingress and TLS certificate management. I used Terraform to provision infrastructure for a small Hetzner VPS. To be precise about the scope of my experience, my production Kubernetes work is at namespace level, while my Terraform and AWS exposure is personal rather than production cloud ownership; I have not used Terragrunt. I am preparing for the CKA exam, scheduled for January 2027.

I would bring a practical automation mindset, experience improving developer workflows, and a habit of making technical systems easier to understand and use. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how this background could contribute to Corvale's fleet-connectivity infrastructure.

Kind regards,
Marta Kowal-Brandt
